authorization.request: start actual training after the completed K4/K5 development comparison

evidence_label.label: final_refit_for_external_confirmation
evidence_label.interpretation: This run freezes a deployment candidate. It does not create a new performance estimate.

prior_evidence.claim_limit: The completed result selected K4-EPE in development only; it did not independently confirm organ specialization.

data.development_data_source: direct extraction from ARCHS4 H5 using only the frozen K45 train+calibration manifest; the historical combined train/calibration/test Parquet is forbidden at runtime

partitions.random_assignment_policy: Reuse the exact K45 K4-EPE connected-study-atomic train and calibration assignments; merge without repartitioning or relabeling.

training.architecture: frozen pooled ExpressionPerformer trunk plus dimension-64 residual adapters
training.candidate: four hard-dispatched adapters for brain, liver, skeletal muscle, and skin; adipose uses pooled fallback
training.pooled_residual_control: one dimension-64 residual adapter applied to every row with no router or fallback
training.sampling: deterministic organ-then-sample balanced cycle over the complete 2,657-row fitting pool; the identical sample/mask stream is shared by every bank within a seed and its ordered 12,000-draw ledger plus per-draw mask seeds are serialized
training.initialization: scratch residual adapters with stable semantic keys per training seed; never warm-start from K45 adapters

random_control_mapping.source: completed K45 held-out calibration expert_mse arrays before final refitting
random_control_mapping.aggregation: average MSE across training seeds per sample, average samples within connected study, then equal-weight studies within active organ
random_control_mapping.selection: argmin expert within each random partition and organ; exact ties choose the lowest expert index
random_control_mapping.external_blind_use: final router predicted organ then frozen random mapping then corresponding final-refit random expert

router.target_hiding: replace all 4634 score genes with mask token before scaler fit and every prediction
router.deployment: predicted adipose uses pooled; each other predicted class uses its same-named organ adapter

future_external_confirmation.required_independence: no accession, publication, BioProject, biosample, donor, sample, or near-duplicate overlap with any prior train, calibration, or test row
future_external_confirmation.primary_aggregation: mean seed-level loss per sample, equal connected-study mass within organ, then equal organ mass

acceptance_gates.blind_k4_vs_pooled: point gain >=3%, clustered CI above zero, residual-Pearson CI above zero
acceptance_gates.true_k4_vs_pooled: point gain >=3% and clustered CI above zero
acceptance_gates.true_k4_vs_each_assigned_random: point gain >=3%, clustered CI above zero, Holm-adjusted p<=0.05
acceptance_gates.blind_k4_vs_each_mapped_random: point gain >0, clustered CI above zero, Holm-adjusted p<=0.05
acceptance_gates.seed_stability: positive blind and true effects for every seed; seed SD <=0.5 times mean
acceptance_gates.active_organ_safety: nonnegative true-dispatch point effect for each active organ
